Senses.Explanation: Literally "hand over, entrust" (付) the "teaching" (法): "entrust the teaching," attested 608 times in 143 allowlisted texts. Lamp records use it for a named predecessor handing the teaching to a successor: "after the buddha's extinction, the teaching was entrusted to Kasyapa and mind was transmitted by mind" (佛滅後付法於迦葉，以心傳心). Narrative closure frequently says "after the patriarch had entrusted the teaching" (祖付法已), followed by his departure or death. The compound "verse on entrusting the teaching" (付法偈) names verses spoken or recorded at that handover.
Senses.Note: The verses themselves often question the wording of transmission. One early verse says, "originally a teaching was entrusted; after entrusting it, [one] says there is no teaching; each must awaken for oneself; once awakened, there is no no-teaching" (本來付有法，付了言無法，各各須自悟，悟了無無法). A later preface asks why transmission verses are recorded for earlier buddhas and patriarchs but not below Mazu: was there no entrustment, or was it kept from disclosure? Another instruction ranks a thousand who have opened up below one person entrusted with the teaching, and a thousand entrusted below one who goes out into the world. These are text-stated comparisons within the same verb sense.

Occurrences.Kwic: 又佛滅後付法於迦葉，以心傳心
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 祖堂集, Guifeng Zongmi section, Reply to the Ten Questions of Layman Shi. Shi Zhicheng is the exact questioner: the headword occurs in his ninth question, and the colophon identifies the questioner as 史制誠; Guifeng Zongmi answers only after this stored turn.

Occurrences.Kwic: 從上佛祖皆見有付法偈
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 介菴進禪師語錄, preface to Jie'an Wujin's verses on transmission sources. Jie'an Wujin is the exact speaker: responding to disciples' request, he says that former buddhas and patriarchs are all seen to have Dharma-transmission verses and then explains why he records their transmission phrases.

Occurrences.Kwic: 本來付有法付了言無法各各須自悟悟了無無法阿難付法眼藏竟。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄: complete-case exact-turn review identifies Ananda as the actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 祖付法已。即現神變而入涅槃。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元), biography of the Tenth Patriarch Parshva (脇尊者). Parshva is the exact grammatical actor: after entrusting the teaching to Punyayashas, he manifests transformations and enters nirvana.

Occurrences.Kwic: 千個省發者不如一付法者，千個付法者不如一出世者。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 大休珠禪師語錄, general address on Dharma transmission. Daxiu Zhu is the exact speaker: he ranks a thousand students below one who awakens, a thousand awakened people below one entrusted with the Dharma, and a thousand such recipients below one who appears in the world to teach.
